symptom: A page or snippet in an app module that calls a snippet of a protected (add-on) module passed `check --references`; mxbuild refuses it: [CE1406] "Snippet call 'sc1' is not allowed to use snippet 'Lib.Sn' because app modules cannot reference hidden elements in add-on modules." Found on Studio Pro's TeamcenterExtension.mxmodule, whose one snippet is stored Hidden and absent from its api.json.
cause: validateProtectedModuleRefs (mendixlabs/mxcli#1498) judged navigation, menus and flows only; created pages and snippets were never a source, and snippet targets had no case.
file: mdl/executor/validate_protected_module_refs.go (checkSnippetCalls / snippetRef / snippetExists; page and snippet statements added to hasProtectedModuleCandidates)
insight: Measure the export level's effect before reading it: with the snippet's stored ExportLevel patched to API, mx check (11.12.6) still refused the call, exactly as #1498 had measured for pages, so the rule is 'add-on module => refused' and no level read is needed. Controls: the same call from inside the add-on, and with the module set back to App (0 errors). Not covered: snippet calls added by ALTER PAGE/SNIPPET inserts, and add-on to add-on calls, which the check does not judge for any element.
